title: Bashar: Interstellar Alliance Social Experiment: Step 1
author: Nflow
session_date_or_event: 2024 (start of new cycle after 40 years of transmission); official event Feb 17, 2024
opening_summary: Bashar announces the beginning of a new cycle in 2024 after 40 years of transmission, introducing the 'Interstellar Alliance Social Experiment' with approximately 11 steps designed to increase humanity's vibrational frequency toward ET contact. The experiment offers no obligation but presents suggested actions and participation to align with the vibrational frequency of open contact in coming years. Bashar emphasizes free will, explaining that engagement depends entirely on individual choice and perceived benefit.

qa_topics.question: Why should we attempt contact with the Interstellar Alliance?
qa_topics.answer_gist: There are no shoulds; contact is entirely optional. The benefit comes from expanding awareness through diverse perspectives and information from multiple civilizations, enriching one's life experience.

qa_topics.question: How will not doing the social experiments affect contact chances?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Non-participation won't decrease contact chances but won't increase them. Completion of steps directly correlates to vibrational alignment; doing 50% of steps achieves roughly 50% of necessary frequency.
